name: Jiangsu SOPO Chemical Co. Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu SOPO Chemical Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in China and internationally. The company offers glacial acetic acid and acetic acid, ethyl acetate, sulfuric acid, ADC foaming agent, chlor-alkali, chlorobenzene, fatty alcohols, and chloroacetic acid; industrial synthetic hydrochloric acid, industrial sodium hydroxide, p-dichlorobenzene, o-dichlorobenzene, and chlorobenzene; and downstream products, ion-exchange membranes, polyols, dichlorobenzene, and air separation products.
